column1: # Evidence ledger (2026-11-16): the cumulative byte-identity list. Every row is re-checked by env/tools/ledger_check.sh after every build.
# Columns: id, kind, method, list, root, local, verified_copy, remote, published, note.
#   method sha256c: (cd root && sha256sum -c list); list is relative to the research directory or absolute.
#   method parts: (cd root && sha256sum -c PARTS.sha256) for a bundle directory.
#   The four states are kept apart: local = the bytes are on this machine; verified_copy = a second copy checked by stream
#   (bundle or xz copy, where); remote = a copy outside this machine (none yet: nothing is pushed); published = in the public repository.
#   A directory removed because every file of it is byte-identical to the file of a kept directory at the same path
#   (first use 2026-11-18, records/reclaim-20261118): the row and its list stay; root = the kept directory, so the check still reads every
#   byte the list names; local = "removed <date>; bytes in <row of the kept directory>"; the note names the removed
#   directory and the listing that showed the identity. A row is never pointed at a directory that such a row names.

#   A directory replaced by a compressed archive (first use 2026-11-19, records/closure-c1prep-20261119/reclaim; results 12.10 item 2 allows it for the option-off extract rounds and the intermediate option-on rounds only): method parts, root = the archive directory (PARTS.sha256 names the archive's sha256, MEMBERS.sha256 is a copy of the list), list = the directory's member list, checked file by file against a stream of the archive before the directory was removed; local = "replaced <date> by an xz tar archive"; verified_copy names the round trip.

#   Second use of the compressed archive, 2026-11-19 (records/closure-space-20261119; results 26.0 (k) and 26.2): the kept extract rounds and the order and relations rounds of the tool rounds before the current one (cz_*) that no step still to run reads (listing.tsv and chosen.tsv there), with the same columns as above; the byte-identical directories of that step follow the 2026-11-18 convention above.

#   Third use of the compressed archive, 2026-11-19 (records/closure-space2-20261119; results 26.7 item (b), space, and 26.8): the kept outputs of results 26.3 (obs1/xr5_*: dry runs, regression, evaluation, candidate re-run and synthetic records) that neither the boot step, the boot declaration nor a freeze file reads (listing.tsv and chosen.tsv there), with the same columns as above.
